Harvest for Hunger Campaign Kickoff Luncheon

Feb 26 2027
Harvest for Hunger Campaign Kickoff Luncheon

Please join the Akron-Canton Regional Foodbank for an exciting luncheon to celebrate the kick off of the 36th annual Harvest for Hunger Campaign. You’ll hear campaign updates and learn about ways to get involved in this year's campaign.


John S. Knight Center, 77 E. Mill Street, Akron
